Although the 5½ mile course was wet the stoney paths helped the faster track men to a good start and after 2 miles the 250 strong field was led by 4 Belgravians - Oliver Foote, Mark Sinclair, John Gladwin and Dave North, with Andy North and Francis Ward not far behind.
Tension and excitement were running very high but Mark Sinclair kept a cool head to produce the winning double. We'll certainly have a return match in the winter.

STAGE TWO saw Mark Sinclair in a determined mood and made up seven places. Next on STAGE THREE came Dave North and Dave winning Bels fastest long stage of the day gained nine places and we were up to 16th.
Mark Sinclair was another to smash his previous best, as a sparkling 8.44.88 gave him 6th place in the 'chase with Mike Hayes also under 9 minutes in the heats.
Mark Sinclair's steeplechase season got underway with his CBP, while in the Discus, Ken's new CBP was almost overshadowed by Abi's breakthrough into +50 meter throwing.

Also Mike Alleyne, 49.79 400m ht; Phil Lovell 4.70 and 11th place (PV); Derrick Williams, three fouls after a 7.19w Long Jump qualifier; Abi Ekoku, 17th in the Discus with 45.50; Mark Sinclair, retiring from the 'chase after starting with a heavy cold and then cracking a knee badly on a barrier.

Twelve wins were again recorded and included Gary Staines running away from Dave Baptiste, Phil Goedluck, Mark Sinclair, Derrick Williams (Long and Triple), Ken and Abi in the Discus, Phil Lovell and Mike Hayes and Simon Maynard in the Chase.

Into the bell in the 1500m and they've shed the pacemaker, Stu' Paton (entry fee sponsored by Oliver Foote to set up a sub 4!) Mark Sinclair looks a picture of relaxation and goes on to a sixth successive win. The next three hung on for pb's - Olly, Frank Ward (behind Mark) and John Booth in his seasonal debut after injury!
